name: fork-rsync-status
title: Fork Sync Status
description: Check whether your fork is in sync with its source (upstream) repository using the gh CLI.
author: sujha

commands.name: check-sync
commands.title: Check Fork Sync Status
commands.subtitle: Fork Sync Status
commands.description: Compare your fork against its source repo and list the upstream commits you are missing.

preferences.name: forkRepo
preferences.title: Fork Repository
preferences.description: Your fork, in owner/name format (e.g. sujha/api). This is the repo whose sync status is checked.

preferences.name: sourceRepo
preferences.title: Source Repository
preferences.description: The upstream/source repo you forked from, in owner/name format (e.g. acme/api). Leave blank to auto-detect from the fork's parent on GitHub.

preferences.name: forkBranch
preferences.title: Fork Branch
preferences.description: Branch on the fork to compare. Leave blank to use the fork's default branch.

preferences.name: sourceBranch
preferences.title: Source Branch
preferences.description: Branch on the source repo to compare against. Leave blank to use the source's default branch.

preferences.name: ghPath
preferences.title: gh CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to the gh executable. Leave empty for auto-detection.
